name: Muku
source:
A girl went to work for our guy to pay her family debt. Our guy already has a butler(male), secretary(female), and maid(young female). He can train the new girl to be a maid, secretary, slave or fun object. What she does when she pay off her debt depends on how he had treated her. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
一个女孩去为我们的男人工作以偿还她的家庭债务。我们的家伙已经有管家（男）、秘书（女）和女佣（年轻女）。他可以训练新女孩成为女仆、秘书、奴隶或有趣的对象。当她还清债务时，她会做什么取决于他如何对待她。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403170830/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wnm.htm]李的欢乐屋[/url]]
